scientific_question: Can candidate-specific active-column, cardinality, operator-mode, materialization, and governance work explain and rank legal DuckDB physical candidates without a direct winner classifier?

measurement_protocol.machine_state: No concurrent CPU-, memory-, or disk-intensive user workload. Ordinary terminal display is allowed.
measurement_protocol.cache_regime: Warm repeated execution in one DuckDB process and connection.
measurement_protocol.candidate_order: Deterministically shuffled Latin rotations; every candidate occupies every order position exactly once per unit.
measurement_protocol.interruption: Stop with Ctrl+C and resume the same run with --resume latest; partial units never enter final artifacts.
measurement_protocol.background_load_violation: Preserve the run as a contaminated development artifact and start a newly identified clean run. Never overwrite or silently relabel it.

feature_and_label_boundary.optimizer_inputs: Only label-free ExecutionAwareWorkVector values derived before candidate execution.
feature_and_label_boundary.target: Warm-cache median candidate latency in milliseconds within a complete seed unit.
feature_and_label_boundary.result_equivalence: Candidates are compared only within their declared equivalence group.
feature_and_label_boundary.governance: Policy legality is a hard pre-cost gate; illegal candidates are neither fitted nor ranked.
feature_and_label_boundary.byte_claim: Feature bytes are logical active-column estimates, not DuckDB internal copy telemetry.
feature_and_label_boundary.current_ea0_timing_use: The 20260722T055455911174Z run may validate mechanisms and the feature schema but must not fit calibration parameters because concurrent user workload was disclosed.

analytic_model_protocol.model_family: Nonnegative additive component-cost model plus one nonnegative query intercept.
analytic_model_protocol.feature_scaling: Use the frozen physical units already emitted by ExecutionAwareWorkVector; scaling parameters are fitted inside each training fold only.
analytic_model_protocol.coefficient_constraint: Every component rate and intercept is greater than or equal to zero.
analytic_model_protocol.lambda_selection: Select inside the training portion of each outer fold by mean candidate log-latency error; never use the outer family.
analytic_model_protocol.identifiability_gate: Report feature rank and collinearity. Components that cannot be separately identified must be merged by a documented physical meaning before a new protocol; arbitrary coefficients are rejected.
analytic_model_protocol.out_of_support_behavior: choose the frozen stable legal fallback

validation_protocol.outer_group: Complete row_count + identifier_width + match_rate scenario family, including all three data seeds and all legal candidates.
baselines: fixed stable legal candidate per equivalence group
fixed pre-Join Mask candidate where present
fixed post-Join Mask candidate where present

decision_rule.pass: Freeze the analytic model and its support envelope, then design an entirely new real-data month/query-family validation protocol before any residual correction.
decision_rule.fail: Retain the complete negative result. Diagnose missing physical work or non-identifiability, but do not change weights, thresholds, folds, or candidate membership and reuse this run as a fresh evaluation.

not_authorized_by_this_phase: a claim of optimizer superiority on real data
a residual or black-box winner model
reuse of consumed Phase 2G as a holdout
